$comment: Licenses a redistributed telflo dependency may carry: only licenses that allow redistribution. Every change here needs that check.

exceptions.$comment: Package name, or name@version to except only the version that was checked, -> reason. Only for a package whose lockfile license field is missing or non-SPDX but whose actual license was checked by hand and is allowed. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can verify.
exceptions.posthog-js@1.376.0: LICENSE is Apache-2.0, with MIT-licensed portions from Sentry, Meta (metro) and Expo; all allowed; hand-checked at 1.376.0.

vendored.$comment: Folder (relative to this file) -> what was vendored, its licenses (each an SPDX expression the allowed list must satisfy) and each file's sha256. check-licenses.mjs fails on a disallowed license, a file not listed, a missing file or a changed sha256. Recorded with its source and integrity in docs/third-party-assets.md.

../telflo-core/apps/api/src/modules/publ.licensesNote: swagger-ui-bundle.js.LICENSE.txt is PARTIAL (webpack keeps only preserved banners): the bundle also holds zenscroll (Unlicense), remarkable (MIT), short-unique-id and apidom (Apache-2.0).

goModules.$comment: Go module@version -> reason. Read only by services/ottl-evaluator/scripts/check-licenses.sh: a module named here, at exactly this version, may carry MPL-2.0 (and no other license outside "allowed"). Reviewed MPL-2.0 dependencies of the ottl-evaluator, used unmodified; MPL-2.0's file-level copyleft reaches only their own files. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can verify; another version, or another MPL module, still fails.
goModules.github.com/hashicorp/go-version@v1.9.0: MPL-2.0 (LICENSE), reviewed at v1.9.0: reached through pkg/ottl by go.opentelemetry.io/collector/featuregate, linked unmodified; its source at https://github.com/hashicorp/go-version/tree/v1.9.0.
goModules.github.com/hashicorp/golang-lru@v1.0.2: MPL-2.0 (LICENSE), reviewed at v1.0.2: reached through pkg/ottl's ottlfuncs by github.com/ua-parser/uap-go (its cache; the module's root and simplelru packages), linked unmodified; its source at https://github.com/hashicorp/golang-lru/tree/v1.0.2.
